description: The autoRecord default per context (ADR 01177). The group config sets autoRecord false (DA8), and a spec can't unset a key, so each test runs one case of cli/auto-capture.cjs: a nested doc-detective run with no auto-capture keys, in .tmp/fac/<case>/. Headed Chrome and Firefox record with ffmpeg where the host can capture, and a host that can't adds no step and still passes; headless Firefox runs headed where the host can capture; headless Chrome with an authored record keeps only the author's; false records nothing.

tests.description: Unset in a headed Chrome context: an ffmpeg MP4 where the host can capture.
Unset in a headed Firefox context: an ffmpeg MP4 where the host can capture.
Unset in a headless Firefox context: run headed and recorded where the host can capture.
Headless Chrome with an authored record: one recording, the author's.
